mission.title: Our Commitment
mission.heading: Empowering Rural
mission.desc: We stand shoulder-to-shoulder with the custodians of our indigenous heritage. By bringing world-class veterinary science directly to the village level, we transform traditional cattle rearing into a thriving, scientific, and sustainable livelihood. Every cow saved, every lineage preserved, is a step towards rural prosperity.

profile.bio1: Dr. Niteen Markandeya is a highly qualified and experienced veterinarian with over 35 years of experience in the field of Veterinary Gynaecology & Obstetrics.
profile.bio2: He was the Associate Dean of Veterinary College Parbhani (MAFSU) for 4 years and has served the institute as Professor and Head, Department of Animal Reproduction, Gynaecology & Obstetrics for 15 years.

education.title: Education & Fellowships
items: FISSAR (Fellow of the Indian Society for Study of Animal Reproduction)
FNAVS (Fellow of the National Academy of Veterinary Sciences, India)

items.desc: Extensive experience spanning over three decades in veterinary practice and animal care.
Department of Animal Reproduction, Gynaecology & Obstetrics, COVAS, Parbhani.

additional_info.title: Additional Information
items: Author of numerous research papers and publications.
Presented research papers at national and international conferences.
Actively involved in various professional organizations.

honours.title: Honours & Felicitations
honours.desc: Dr. Markandeya's dedication to veterinary medicine and social good has been richly recognized throughout his career. His numerous honors and felicitations paint a picture of a distinguished professional who has consistently gone above and beyond in his service to animals and communities.

academic.title: Academic & Professional Excellence
items: Chairman/co-chairman of scientific sessions and judging panels at national conferences.
Commendations for academic contributions, research presentations, and successful student academic career management.
Appreciation for excellence in extension work and contributions to animal husbandry activities.
Appointed as a VCI inspector by the Veterinary Council of India to evaluate veterinary colleges nationally.
Nominated as expert for academic selections, career advancements, and special lectures by National Institutes and State Universities.

social.title: Social Impact & Community Service
items: Awarded the Karmath Samaj Sevek award for promoting social equity and reforms through his profession.
Felicitated by the Chief Minister of Maharashtra for his veterinary service in the Marathawada region.
Recognized by the Maharashtra state adult literacy Institute and Vasantrao Naik Pratisthan for contributions to education and animal husbandry.
Delivered a foundation-sponsored oration lecture on achieving success in the veterinary field.

leadership.title: Leadership & Expertise
items: Invited to judge farm animal clinical case management competitions at veterinary universities.
Led multiple online training programs on reproductive sound management topics, earning leadership certificates from pharmaceutical companies.
Acted as a guest speaker for continuing education programs.

corona.title: Dedication During Challenging Times
corona.desc: Appreciated as a Veterinary CORONA Warrior by Alembic for his service to animal health during the pandemic. Dr. Markandeya’s impressive array of honors reflects his unwavering commitment to veterinary excellence, social responsibility, and leadership.

awards.title: Awards & Distinctions
awards.desc: Dr. Niteen Markandeya’s achievements extend far beyond academic excellence. He has been consistently recognized for his dedication to social good, research, and animal husbandry practices.

categories.name: Academic Excellence
items: Secured first position in PG studies at Marathawada Agricultural University.

categories.name: Research & Technical Expertise
items: Nominated for the Young Scientist Award program by the Indian Science Congress for his research paper presentation.
Won several awards for research paper presentations from the Indian Society for Study of Animal Reproduction (ISSAR).
Received the Dr. Rajendra Prasad Hindi Technical Book ICAR Award for his book on 'Deshi Gowansh'.

categories.name: Social Veterinary Service
items: Authored books on animal husbandry for neo-literates, earning three State awards from the Maharashtra state Adult Literacy Institute.
Received numerous awards for his contributions to animal husbandry and dairy activities, including the Vasantrao Naik Award and the Rishabhshree Award.
Recognized for his work on conserving native breeds of animals and promoting rural development.

categories.name: Literary Accolades
items: Won awards for his informative articles and scripts published in various agricultural magazines.
Received the Late R. N. Sabnis Literary Award for his book on rural development.

categories.name: Recognition by Professional Forum
items: Bestowed with the Best Veterinarian Award by the senior veterinarian’s forum, Pune and Aurangabad.
Honored with the Krishiratna Award for his animal husbandry extension activities.
